name: Grand Forks AFB
description: Home of the 319th Reconnaissance Wing. Grand Forks AFB operates RQ-4 Global Hawk missions and provides critical ISR support.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.address: Main Gate, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

gates.name: Commercial Gate (South Gate)
gates.notes: Commercial and limited personal vehicle access. Closed weekends.
gates.address: Commercial Gate, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 812)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; closed federal holidays, down days, and family days
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. After-hours passes at Main Gate.
gates.address: 80 Steen Blvd, Bldg 812, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Airey Dining Facility
resources.description: Campus-style DFAC with seven food stations including Kitchen, Fire & Iron grill, Wrap It Up subs, Ciao Pizza, Greenhouse Salad Bar, Grab-N-Go, and Restaurant Rotation (global cuisine). Open to all with base access.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0900, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830; Sat-Sun: Breakfast 0630-0830, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830
resources.address: 649 John Marshall St, Bldg 315, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Grand Forks Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Grand Forks Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Grand Forks Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities. 24/7 access for registered CAC holders.
resources.hours: See FSS for staffed hours; 24/7 for registered users

resources.name: Warrior Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.
resources.address: Bldg 117, 632 Holzapple Street, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: Bldg 207, 575 Holzapple Street, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: 319th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: 319th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Warrior Inn (701-747-7200) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 319 FSS, M&FRC, and official Grand Forks sites for in-processing and community support.
